name: mast
description: Local machine-learning error classification and mastery tracking for MAST.

commands.title: MAST: Run Python and Capture Error

mast.modelDirectory.description: Optional local directory containing the MAST ONNX files and metadata.json. Empty uses the repository's artifacts/synthetic directory.

mast.gatewayUrl.description: MAST Gateway base URL. Remote URLs must use HTTPS; HTTP is accepted only for localhost development.

mast.telemetryEnabled.description: Share derived interaction metadata with the MAST Gateway for product metrics. Message, error, and code content are never sent to telemetry endpoints.

enumDescriptions: Use the provider key stored in VS Code SecretStorage.
mast.authMode.description: Credential mode for later MAST generation features. Block 7 does not send BYOK keys anywhere.

mast.pythonCommand.description: Python executable path used only by MAST: Run Python and Capture Error. It is launched without a shell.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/auth.test.js out/test/block11.test.js out/test/chat.test.js out/test/inference.test.js out/test/retrieval.test.js
